actions.action: Check whether the grassy shoots at the base belong to the same pot
Water slowly and thoroughly until it drains, possibly repeating to soak, then empty saucer
Check soil moisture with finger or skewer and water when top 2 inches are dry
Place in bright indirect light and gradually move closer to south window over two weeks
Run grow light on a 12-hour timer
Repot in spring into pot 2 inches larger with drainage and peat mix with perlite or bark
Remove fully dead or brown leaves near the base
Inspect undersides of leaves for pests

reason: The answer misidentifies the Crinum as a Dracaena and blames underwatering, but it does touch on low light and recommends a well-draining mix with perlite, partly matching the light and soil fix; it omits warmth and outdoor time, though nothing it suggests is likely to hurt the plant.
